evals.name: overloaded-weekly-queue
evals.prompt: I have 30 papers in this week's queue and only two hours. Triage them in one batch and tell me what I should actually read.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded batch of at most ten active candidates with deep, targeted, cluster-only, skip, or backlog recommendations, followed by one human confirmation checkpoint.
expectations: The workflow does not start ten sequential tutor sessions and does not claim that the learner read any paper.
Every recommendation has at least one controlled reason code and targeted reads name selected sections.
No queue action or taste event is written before the human confirms the whole decision set.

evals.name: skip-is-taste-not-reading
evals.prompt: Skip the duplicate papers and learn from that choice, but do not archive them as completed reads.
evals.expected_output: Confirmed skips become human taste evidence with low-fit or duplicate reasons while remaining explicitly not-read.
expectations: Skipped papers are not exported as full notes, source notes, or completed reads.
The response records the human rationale and reason codes and preserves the queue history.
